title: dianthus orientalis var. brachyodontus
intro: Dianthus orientalis var. brachyodontus, commonly known as the fragrant pink or Asian pink, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the carnation family. The fragrant pink plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including its ability to lower blood pressure and improve cardiovascular health due to its health benefits. Its therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to soothe skin irritations and protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
